mp: Lifestyle piece E — permission & small-joy slips open in-board into a fuller slip
rootCause: ReferenceError: Star is not defined — src/components/lifestyle-elite/LifestyleEliteShell.jsx line 1214 (PermissionSlipLens) renders <Star size={15}/> but 'Star' is NOT in the lucide-react import block (lines 30-31). Tapping ANY permission/small-joy cover card renders PermissionSlipLens, throws, and the top-level ErrorBoundary replaces the WHOLE Lifestyle page with 'Something went wrong'. Piece E is completely non-functional live. One-line fix: add Star to the lucide import.

assertions.name: 1-bottom-shelf-intact
assertions.expected: 'Permission & small joys' label + a row of cover cards (slow Sunday / outside / walk / gentler pace etc.)
assertions.got: label visible; cover titles found: A slow Sunday just for you, A long walk somewhere new, Cook something that takes all afternoon, Visit a gallery alone, A film and an early night, Ten minutes outside no phone (+ permission slips)

assertions.name: 2-slip-opens-in-board
assertions.expected: Tap a cover (e.g. 'You're allowed a slow Sunday.') -> role=dialog FaceOverlay covers board face; big serif title ~24-26px; 'Why this is good for you' block; italic source line; doable button; URL unchanged (no /LifestyleDetail)
assertions.got: NO overlay. Tap throws 'ReferenceError: Star is not defined' -> ErrorBoundary shows full-page 'Something went wrong / We're on it. A quick reload usually fixes it.' with Reload/Go Home. No slip title/why-block/source/doable rendered. URL stayed /Lifestyle (crash, not a route).
assertions.note: P0 crash — see rootCause and screenshot pieceE_slip_crash.png.

assertions.name: 3-honesty-split-kindness-not-claim
assertions.expected: gentler-pace slip overlay header reads 'A kindness, not a claim' (NOT 'Why this is good for you') AND no citation/source line
assertions.got: UNTESTABLE LIVE — the slip overlay crashes before any content renders (same Star error). Source logic IS correct: whyFor('...gentler pace...') -> WHY.cycle (kindness, no cite) -> header 'A kindness, not a claim', no source line (LifestyleEliteShell.jsx lines 148,159,1203-1205). Must be RE-VERIFIED live after the Star fix.
assertions.note: Blocked by the crash; not independently confirmable at pixel level. Anti-fake-science logic is correct in source but unverified live.

assertions.name: 4-doable-ticks-no-nav
assertions.expected: In an open slip, tap doable -> flips to checked 'In your planner' + bloom; URL unchanged; board not scrolled away
assertions.got: UNTESTABLE — no slip overlay renders (crash). No doable button reachable.

assertions.name: 5-back-returns
assertions.expected: Tap Back (aria-label 'Back') -> dialog gone, good-life board visible
assertions.got: No FaceOverlay and no Back arrow — the page is in the top-level ErrorBoundary state (only 'Reload' / 'Go Home'). Good-life board NOT visible after the crash.

assertions.name: 6-regression-piece-d-time-for
assertions.expected: Tap top-shelf 'Time for?' -> FaceOverlay opens with time bands; Back closes
assertions.got: PASS. On a fresh load, 'Time for?' opens the FaceOverlay: 'What have you got time for?' + 'Pick by the time you have — a small, chosen handful'. 'A day for you' also opens ('A whole day that's just yours'). Board + top-shelf grid render intact. (Overlay open takes up to ~1-2s incl. a smooth-scroll; a single short wait misses it.)

assertions.name: 7-no-horizontal-page-overflow
assertions.got: scrollWidth=390, innerWidth=390, delta=0 (measured on fresh load pre-crash)

assertions.name: 8-console-error-classification
assertions.expected: no NEW ReferenceError/TDZ/app-code error beyond baseline
assertions.got: NEW (regression): 'ReferenceError: Star is not defined at Drn (index-DbD-I9MD.js:3343:41451)' + 'UI ErrorBoundary caught: ReferenceError: Star is not defined' — fired on slip tap. PRE-EXISTING baseline (ignored per brief): 'N.entities.User.me is not a function', 'App not found', apps/null 404s, connect_error/socket 'Connection rejected by server'.
assertions.note: The Star ReferenceError is the P0.

newErrors: ReferenceError: Star is not defined (LifestyleEliteShell PermissionSlipLens, line 1214) -> full-page ErrorBoundary

fixTarget.change: Add 'Star' to the imported lucide icons. Used as <Star size={15}/> at line 1214 in PermissionSlipLens.

notes: Piece E is DOA on live: tapping any 'Permission & small joys' cover card throws ReferenceError: Star is not defined (PermissionSlipLens, LifestyleEliteShell.jsx:1214 — Star never imported), and the top-level ErrorBoundary blanks the whole Lifestyle page ('Something went wrong'). Bottom shelf renders (A1) and piece D doorways still work (A6), so this is one missing import, not a structural break. Assertions 2-5 and 8 fail; 3 (the honesty split) is correct in source but could not be pixel-verified because the overlay crashes first. Fix: add Star to the lucide import, redeploy, then re-run this walk to confirm the slip renders, the cited/kindness split shows correctly, and the doable ticks. Verification harness: headless Chromium via playwright-core against the persisted test-user profile (Chrome MCP tools were not loaded this session).
